items.html: And this place of these fourteen Sefirot was then the secret of the boundary of the worlds, in the manner of what we establish for each and every city a Shabbat boundary around it. And this is the secret of what our sages said: why is He called El Shaddai? Because He said to His world "Enough" (Dai). Explanation: for when these four worlds ABYA were expanding, when they reached the place of the end of the sixth Sefira of the present Yetzira, He said to them "Enough" — do not expand, and do not enter into the boundary of the aforementioned fourteen Sefirot; rather, they remain an empty space for the Klipot, as mentioned.
